P.name: Arcane Mastery
P.title: Template:Data Ryze/Arcane Mastery
P.wikitext:
<!--Only edit the numbers if the effects change their values, do NOT edit the formula in the notes, unless riot specifically changes it.
-->{{#vardefine:am|10}}<!-- Arcane Mastery's
-->{{#vardefine:rd|1.3}}<!-- Rabadon's Deathcap's
-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Arcane Mastery|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ryze
|skill        = I
|icon         = Arcane Mastery.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Ryze}} gains {{sti|mana|{{as|'''maximum''' mana}}}} based on his {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ryze''' increases his {{as|{{sti|mana|'''maximum''' mana}}}} by {{as|({{#var:am}}% per 100 AP)}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* Any increase in maximum mana is treated as bonus mana.
* With {{ii|Rabadon's Deathcap}}, a total of {{as|{{#expr: {{cid|Rabadon's Deathcap|ap}} * {{#var:rd}} / {{#var:am}} round 1 }}% ({{as|{{#var:am}}% AP|AP}}) '''maximum''' mana|mana}} is gained.
* ''Arcane Mastery'' together with {{ii|Archangel's Staff}} or {{ii|Seraph's Embrace}} creates a [[Recursion|recursive stat loop]]: {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} giving {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} and so on. 
*Another way to create a [[Recursion|recursive stat loop]], is to have any converter of {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} to {{as|{{sti|health}}}} ({{ii|Winter's Approach}}, {{ii|Fimbulwinter}} or the [[Ultra_Rapid_Fire#Features|U.R.F. buff]]) and {{ii|Riftmaker}}. The first converter giving {{as|{{sti|mana}}}} to {{as|{{sti|health}}}}, {{ii|Riftmaker}} giving {{as|{{sti|health}}}} to {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} and ''Arcane Mastery'' giving {{as|{{sti|ability power}}}} to {{as|{{sti|mana}}}}.
}}

Q.name: Overload
Q.title: Template:Data Ryze/Overload
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Overload|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ryze
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Overload 4.png
|blurbicon    = Overload.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{cis|Ryze}} other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts {{sti|ah|reset}} ''Overload's'' cooldown and generate a ''{{ai|Overload 3|Ryze|Rune}}'' stack, stacking up to 2 times.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' unleashes a runic bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all ''{{ai|Overload 4|Ryze|Rune}}'' stacks.
|blurb3      = If '''Ryze''' consumes the maximum ''{{ai|Overload 4|Ryze|Rune}}'' stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}  for a short time.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Overload'' deals increased damage and spreads to surrounding ''Flux'' enemies.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ryze's''' other {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts reset ''Overload's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and charge a [[File:Overload 3.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' {{tip|stack}} for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 2 times.
|icon2        = Overload.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ryze''' unleashes a runic blast in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and consumes all [[File:Overload 4.png|20px|link=]] ''Rune'' stacks.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|75 to 155}} {{as|(+ 55% AP)}} {{as|(+ 2% '''bonus''' mana)}}}}
|icon3        = Overload 3.png
|description3 = If '''Ryze''' consumed 2 stacks, he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
|leveling3    = {{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|28 to 44}}%}}
|description4 = {{sbc|{{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}} Bonus:}} ''Overload'' deals {{pp|type=[[File:Realm Warp.png|20px|border]] ''Realm Warp's'' Rank|key=%|25 to 100 for 4|0 to 3}} {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} and spreads to surrounding ''Fluxed'' enemies.
|cooldown     = 5
|cost         = {{ap|40 to 32}}
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1000
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 110
|speed        = 1700
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.35}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Special
|projectile   = True
|notes        = 
* ''Overload'' can be buffered {{fd|0.5}} seconds before it comes off cooldown.
* ''Overload'' can be buffered while casting either {{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze}} or {{ai|Rune Prison|Ryze}} to cast immediately after the previous spell's cast time.
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets affected by {{ai|Spell Flux|Ryze|Flux}}.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
}}
